evals.prompt: Make a watercolor Blender garden image with luminous paper lights and soft peripheral edges.
assertions: Uses selective pigment edges rather than universal oil bump.

evals.prompt: The watercolor looks like dirty plastic with uniform noisy bump and a global blur. Repair it.
assertions: Keeps focal edges while softening selected regions.

evals.prompt: Create an oil-painted Blender jug study with directional opaque strokes, a transparent-looking shadow glaze and selective impasto. Preserve the source and distinguish fixed illustration from relightable delivery.
evals.expected_output: Oil-specific source layers and matched value/stroke/raking-light evidence or clearly labeled unexecuted plan.
assertions: Stroke directions describe jug volume rather than isotropic noise.
Impasto and painted color remain independently editable.
Fixed painted highlights versus relighting are stated and tested only if executed.

evals.prompt: A gouache illustration was built using transparent watercolor washes on every surface, and dry-brush texture breaks the whole face into holes. Repair the selected opaque medium without replacing the composition.
evals.expected_output: Restored opaque coverage and selectively masked edge breakup with actual-size comparison.
assertions: Restricts dry marks to chosen edges instead of every interior.
Keeps approved composition and reports actual image review separately.
